edges.reason: Constructor writes the full supply into _balances of the deployer.
Constructor reads _tTotal to mint the initial supply.
Constructor calls _msgSender to obtain the deployer address.
Constructor uses msg.sender as the initial token holder and owner.
Constructor assigns _msgSender() result to the local msgSender variable.
_msgSender returns the untrusted msg.sender value to callers.
approve delegates all state changes to internal _approve.
approve passes msg.sender as the allowance owner.
approve forwards the spender parameter to _approve.
Spender parameter reaches _allowances write through _approve.
transferFrom performs the token movement through _transfer.
transferFrom decreases the allowance via _approve.
transferFrom reads and writes the _allowances mapping.
transferFrom uses msg.sender as the spender of the allowance.
transferFrom uses the sender parameter for the balance source.
transferFrom uses the recipient parameter for the destination.
transferFrom uses the amount parameter for balances and allowance.
transfer performs the token movement through _transfer.
transfer uses msg.sender as the sender of the funds.
transfer uses the recipient parameter as destination.
transfer uses the amount parameter for the moved value.
_transfer subtracts from and adds to _balances entries.
_transfer compares recipient with _tBotAddress for the max amount check.
_transfer compares sender with _tBlackAddress to bypass the cap.
_transfer reads _maxBlack in the transfer restriction require.
_transfer executes the balance mutation unsafe operation.
sender parameter flows into the _transfer balance logic.
recipient parameter flows into the _transfer balance logic.
amount parameter flows into the _transfer balance logic.
setFeeTotal mints arbitrary tokens, a privileged supply inflation operation.
setFeeTotal credits the caller balance and uses _msgSender in checks.
setFeeTotal adds the amount to _tTotal.
setFeeTotal increases _balances of the caller.
setFeeTotal is protected by the onlyOwner modifier reading _owner.
Mint amount parameter determines the newly created supply value.
setMaxTxBlack multiplies the caller percent without checked arithmetic.
setMaxTxBlack assigns the computed value to _maxBlack.
setMaxTxBlack is restricted by onlyOwner against _owner.
maxTxBlackPercent parameter is the unchecked multiplication operand.
setBlackListBot changes privileged bot address state.
setBlackListBot writes the new value into _tBotAddress.
setBlackListBot is guarded by onlyOwner reading _owner.
blackListAddress parameter becomes the stored bot address.
setBlackAddress changes privileged black address state.
setBlackAddress writes the new value into _tBlackAddress.
setBlackAddress is guarded by onlyOwner reading _owner.
blackAddress parameter becomes the stored black address.
transferOwnership overwrites _owner with the new owner.
newOwner parameter is written into the _owner state variable.
transferOwnership checks the caller through _msgSender in onlyOwner.
Ownership authorization compares _owner against the untrusted msg.sender.
_approve writes the allowance amount into _allowances.
allowance view reads the _allowances mapping.
balanceOf view reads the _balances mapping.
totalSupply view reads the _tTotal state variable.
_approve consumes the spender parameter for its zero-address check and write.

normalization_plan.reason: Address parameter is only used to overwrite _tBotAddress inside the setter, so it collapses into the setter node.
Address parameter is only used to overwrite _tBlackAddress inside the setter, so it collapses into the setter node.
Mint amount feeds directly into the unsafe minting operation, so it is merged into that unsafe operation node.
The percent parameter is the sole operand of the unchecked multiplication, so it merges into the arithmetic unsafe operation.
Sender parameter only drives balance subtraction in the internal transfer routine, so it merges into _transfer.
Recipient parameter only drives balance addition in the internal transfer routine, so it merges into _transfer.
Amount parameter only determines the moved value in the internal transfer routine, so it merges into _transfer.
New owner parameter is written directly into _owner by transferOwnership, so it merges into that function.
Constructor-local address is a temporary holder of _msgSender(), so it merges into the constructor node.
Spender parameter is consumed only by _approve for validation and allowance write, so it merges into _approve.
